published_prior_art.cite: PimentelAlarconNowakBoston2015 gives the generic coordinate-subspace iff; it does not give equal complete observed causal-law transports.

PimentelAlarconNowakBoston2015, Theorem 1: for almost every rank-r subspace, uniqueness holds iff every selected-column subpattern has at least n+r nonzero rows; at r=2 this is the stated |F|≤|V(F)|−2 anchor-triple condition.
LeiRoss2023 supplies O3 sufficiency, not the asserted strict O3-to-pebble containment or four-mask separation.
YanWainwright2024 has a different growing staggered-adoption matrix experiment and does not construct fixed-T same-shell cohort-law pairs.
No checked source supplies the proposed fixed-T, complete-observed-law, same-relation-shell deformation.
LeiRoss2023 proves regular asymptotic linearity under a gap condition, not the conditional shell minimax frontier over this complete-law class.
AndrewsCheng2012 supplies broad weak-identification robust inference, not shortest simultaneous rectangles for this cohort-moment shell.
No checked result gives the stated necessary-and-sufficient Ns_N^2 phase transition for this shell experiment.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 2
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed generic rank/count reduction is the rank-two restatement of Pimentel-Alarcon, Nowak, and Boston's published necessary-and-sufficient deterministic subspace-identifiability criterion; retain only a genuinely new causal-law transport or computational consequence.

soundness_flags.label: def:moment-inversion; Theorem 5
soundness_flags.one_line: The “simultaneous radius-rho confidence ball” has no specified norm, construction, or finite-sample coverage/tail guarantee, and the full-box fallback lacks a failure-probability bound sufficient for the asserted expected-width rate.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 2; Theorems 4–5; Proposition 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Legal same-shell deformation is an explicit unresolved premise, not an established lower-experiment construction.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The two-sided minimax, honest-width, and necessity claims are accepted only conditional on a uniform affirmative answer to Open-ended Question 2; unconditional claims are limited to the stated upper bounds.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For almost every r-dimensional subspace, uniqueness is equivalent to every submatrix formed from selected sampling columns satisfying m(Omega') >= n(Omega')+r.
O3 iteratively merges cohorts with at least r shared observed outcomes; the paper gives fixed-T consistency/asymptotic linearity under its identification and regularity assumptions.
Generic rank-r matrix entry completability and generic stress rank are properties of the observed positions under genericity.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:math/0703921, precursor to Eur. J. Comb. 30 (2009)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper characterizes sparse hypergraphs through pebble-game constructibility and gives decision/extraction/component algorithms.
The paper studies staggered-adoption missing-panel entrywise inference, high-probability error bounds, and an instance-wise Bayesian-Cramer-Rao lower bound.
The paper studies minimax/adaptivity consequences of weak or unknown factor strength in large factor models and panel regressions.
The paper establishes uniform weak-, semi-strong-, and strong-identification inference for broad extremum-model classes.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Delete or demote Theorem 2 as a standalone novelty claim; make its distinct target the complete-observed-law transport, an explicit causal consequence not entailed by the published subspace criterion.
Specify the observed-moment confidence norm, estimator, feasibility rule, and a failure-tail argument that makes the full-box fallback contribution o((sqrt(N)s_N)^-1) on regular shells.

Strengthen the O3 comparison from a single-algorithm separation to a generic class of overlap-merging certificates or add a second named comparator, while retaining the four-mask witness as a regression test.

recommended_next_step: Revise the published-overlap framing of the pebble reduction and make moment inversion fully specified before advancing the conditional shell-frontier angle.
